title: Before You Go
summary: Compare live views from 21 destinations across Taiwan. Pick up to three and check the scenery, temperature, and rainfall before you head out.
summaryZhTW: 從臺灣 21 個景點選出兩到三處，並排看看即時風景、氣溫與雨量，再決定今天去哪裡。
controls: Choose two or three destinations, then select Compare. Enlarge a camera for a closer look.
limitations: Live video and station readings depend on the original providers. Observation times appear beneath the camera views.

approval.note: Creator approved public release and the illustrated Possibility Apps card.

coverAlt: Before You Go travel poster depicting a Taiwanese harbor, green mountain ridges, and Pacific surf.
